summary: fractal-ui shows a host-recorded mailbox delivery as an incoming message card with sender, subject and a verified or unverified mark

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Only packages/fractal-ui changes. The conversation model's user Text item gains an optional delivery (IncomingDelivery: messageId, from, optional to, title and provenance verdict). Hosts that omit it render user prompts unchanged. The card claims verification only when the recorded verdict is verified; every other verdict, and a missing provenance, reads Unverified.
